name: PTR character copy: .ptr copy on the source realm queues one copy for the target realm
contract: On the source realm a player copies their own character with .ptr copy <name> (src/server/coa/CoAPtrCharacterCopy.cpp): the realm saves the online character, writes its PlayerDump and queues it in the shared auth table coa_ptr_copy_request; the target realm loads queued copies on its poll, and the source realm then tells the player. The copy is a new character on the same account that carries the inventory and its own Personal Bank; player mail it holds comes from the copy itself, so returning it cannot reach an unrelated character there; a name already taken there is renamed at login. A character keeps at most one live copy, and a player cannot copy a character of another account or an unknown name. ptr_character_copy makes this realm both the source and the target.
